mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.2% indicates an ultra-loose monetary policy that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing start volume exceeding 700 thousand units and real sales above $400 billion indicate robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST > 700 and RSAFS > 400000.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a monthly industrial production decline below 98.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0 during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A housing start volume above 700 thousand units consistently signals strong consumer demand for housing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 700.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI index exceeding 225 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll employment growth above 130,000 and unemployment rate decline below 8.5% indicate a robust labor market that increases household income and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000 and UNRATE < 8.5.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, suppressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5 during monetary tightening cycles.
